responsibility: Owns rustc's target-level ABI registry for `extern` function ABIs, defining the `Abi` enum, the canonical name-to-ABI mapping, ABI stability and feature-gating checks, varargs support rules, and the stable indexing/data lookup used by target-spec and metadata code.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/mod.rs`, which models low-level type layout, and `abi/call/mod.rs`, which lowers calls, this `mod.rs` is the target-level registry of `extern` ABIs: the `Abi` enum, canonical names, stability/feature gating, varargs support, and stable indexing.
